topologyPolicy.decision: Use route groups for walked official route topology and connections for transfers between route entries.

routeGroupKinds.mainline: Primary continuous official section chain for the selected trail model.
routeGroupKinds.branch: Official alternate or side branch that can be hiked as trail, but should not be silently merged into the mainline.
routeGroupKinds.access: Official or strongly supported approach route to/from public transport, village, trailhead or another trail.
routeGroupKinds.connector: Walked link between route groups or nearby route sections where it is part of the trail model.

topologyPolicy.connectionsUse: Use connections.json-style records for non-section transfers or continuity records between sections: ferry, bus, road transfer, rowboat, short walk transfer, same-island continuity, or mode none for a known gap with no usable transfer geometry.
topologyPolicy.officialRowboatRule: If a rowboat crossing is an official route entry in its own right, model it as a section route with strong warnings. Otherwise model it as a rowboat connection or access/side metadata.

importOrder.notes: Validate schema, coordinate order, distance tolerances and endpoint graph without writing runtime app data.

importOrder.sections: All sections except N5, K3 and K4
importOrder.notes: Carry long-internal-segment draw-ready caveats; defer publication until facility/rule policies are resolved.
Import only after deciding how official MultiLineString breaks are represented.
Treat K4-to-K5 as an explicit official network gap; do not imply continuous coastal coverage through Falkenberg/Varberg.
Run dedupe, GIS overlays and live checks before user-facing publication.

endpointContinuityIssues: N5 has four-part MultiLineString/gap handling and the practical endpoint is at Gallarpasjon/Gallarp rather than Nosslinge church.
N8 official GPX endpoint sits about 60-65 m from the shared Akulla junction.
S1/S2 handoff gap at Oskarstrom is 2.94 m.
K1/K2 handoff gap at Kungsbacka C is about 17 m.
K3 has official gaps of about 203 m near Nasungevagen/Mor Annas vag and 111 m near Badviksvagen/Asa beach.
K4-to-K5 is a large official coastal gap and K5/K6 Haverdal handoff is about 13 m.
K6/K7 handoff is about 1 m, K7/K8 is about 5.34 m, K8/K9 is about 3.23 m, and K9/K10 is about 10.82 m.
Branch nodes at Akulla, Astad/Byasjon, Kvarnforsen, Frodeparken, Gyltige, Simlangsdalen, Halmstad C and Koarp need explicit graph/topology decisions rather than a single linear chain.
blockedGeometry: None missing locally; hard geometry blockers are policy decisions around official breaks, endpoint snapping and the K4-to-K5 official coastal network gap.

decisionsApplied.decision: Treat the K4 Frillesas to K5 Steninge break as an official network gap, not a missing connector to invent.

connections.importPolicy: Keep visible as two coastal chains unless an official connector is later published.
Use shared-node topology at Akulla/Ästad/Byasjön/Kvarnforsen/Gyltige/Frodeparken/Oskarström/Koarp only after preserving original endpoints in provenance.

remainingGeometryWork: Run protected-area and water-protection GIS overlays against the selected canonical lines before public rule warnings.
